summary.description: Two or three sentences on what changes and why it is or isn't safe to automerge

notes.description: What changed between the versions that matters for this cluster

sources.description: Release note / changelog URLs actually read

breaking_changes.description: Breaking changes that affect this repo's config, each citing the file it affects

deprecations.description: Deprecations of things this repo uses, each citing the file it affects

required_actions.description: Manual steps a human must take that cannot be done in the repo (e.g. backups, one-off migrations)

new_features.description: New features worth adopting here, each naming the file it would change

fix_applied.description: True only if you edited repo files to make the update safe

fix_description.description: What was edited and why; empty if fix_applied is false
